segments.ja481:1.1: Ahameva dubbhāsitaṃ bhāsi bālo, bhekovaraññe ahimavhāyamāno [mavhayāno (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja481:1.3: Takkāriye sobbhamimaṃ [sobbhamhi ahaṃ (ka.)] patāmi, na kireva sādhu ativelabhāṇī [sādhūtyativelabhāṇī (ka.)].
segments.ja481:2.1: Pappoti macco ativelabhāṇī, bandhaṃ vadhaṃ sokapariddavañca;
segments.ja481:2.3: Attānameva garahāsi ettha, ācera yaṃ taṃ nikhaṇanti sobbhe.
segments.ja481:3.1: Kimevahaṃ tuṇḍilamanupucchiṃ, kareyya saṃ [kareyyāsaṃ (syā.), kareyya sa (ka.), bhareyya saṃ (?)] bhātaraṃ kāḷikāyaṃ [kāḷikāya (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja481:3.3: Naggovahaṃ [naggoca’ haṃ (?)] vatthayugañca jīno, ayampi attho bahutādisova.
segments.ja481:4.1: Yo yujjhamānānamayujjhamāno [yujjhamānena ayujjhamāno (ka.)], meṇḍantaraṃ accupatī kuliṅgo;
segments.ja481:4.3: So piṃsito meṇḍasirehi tattha, ayampi attho bahutādisova.
segments.ja481:5.1: Caturo janā potthakamaggahesuṃ, ekañca posaṃ anurakkhamānā;
segments.ja481:5.3: Sabbeva te bhinnasirā sayiṃsu, ayampi attho bahutādisova.
segments.ja481:6.1: Ajā yathā veḷugumbasmiṃ baddhā [bandhaṃ (syā. ka.)], avakkhipantī asimajjhagacchi;
segments.ja481:6.3: Teneva tassā galakāvakantaṃ [galayā vikantuṃ (ka.), galakaṃ vikantā (syā.)], ayampi attho bahutādisova.
segments.ja481:7.1: Ime na devā na gandhabbaputtā, migā ime atthavasaṃ gatā me [atthavasābhatā ime (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja481:7.3: Ekañca naṃ sāyamāse pacantu, ekaṃ punappātarāse [ekañca naṃ pātarāse (ka. sī. pī.)] pacantu.
segments.ja481:8.1: Sataṃ sahassāni dubhāsitāni, kalampi nāgghanti subhāsitassa;
segments.ja481:8.3: Dubbhāsitaṃ saṅkamāno kileso [kilissati (?)], tasmā tuṇhī kimpurisā [kiṃpuriso (sī. syā.)] na bālyā.
segments.ja481:9.1: Yā mesā byāhāsi [byākāsi (sī. syā. pī.)] pamuñcathetaṃ, giriñca naṃ [giriṃ varaṃ (ka.)] himavantaṃ nayantu;
segments.ja481:9.3: Imañca kho dentu mahānasāya, pātova naṃ pātarāse pacantu.
segments.ja481:10.3: Tvaṃ nāthosi [tvaṃ-nātho’ smi (sī. syā. pī.)] mahārāja, nāthohaṃ bhariyāya me [amha-nāthā mama bhariyā (ka. sī. syā.)];
segments.ja481:11.1: Na ve nindā suparivajjayetha [suparivajjayātha (syā.)], nānā janā sevitabbā janinda;
segments.ja481:11.3: Yeneva eko labhate pasaṃsaṃ, teneva añño labhate ninditāraṃ.
segments.ja481:12.1: Sabbo loko paricitto aticitto [paracittena aticitto (sī. syā.), paracittena acitto (sī. aṭṭha.)], sabbo loko cittavā samhi citte;
segments.ja481:12.3: Paccekacittā puthu sabbasattā, kassīdha cittassa vase na vatte.
segments.ja481:13.1: Tuṇhī ahū kimpuriso sabhariyo [abhāṇī (ka.)], yo dāni byāhāsi bhayassa bhīto;
segments.ja481:13.3: So dāni mutto sukhito arogo, vācākirevattavatī narānanti.
